assets.name: Workloads
assets.originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity macOS native app redesign concept for Micropod.
Primary request: Reimagine a fast macOS developer utility for running containers and persistent Linux microVMs, showing workloads, resources, logs and local caching together. Produce an exceptionally polished, buildable native SwiftUI interface.
Scene/backdrop: straight-on flat screenshot of ONE large macOS application window on a very restrained neutral desktop. Landscape 16:10 composition. Window nearly fills canvas with a small margin. Native traffic lights, unified toolbar, quiet translucent sidebar. No device frame.
Style/medium: crisp detailed UI screenshot, fine system typography like SF Pro, code in SF Mono. Calm graphite dark mode, precise hairline separators, Micropod blue accent consistent with its existing blue pod/terminal identity. Minimal visual noise, generous panel padding with compact meaningful rows. Color is used only for selection, status and data. No huge tiles.
Composition: 190pt sidebar, spacious central workload table, 340pt right inspector, slim bottom activity strip. Branded toolbar reads "Micropod", tiny blue pod/terminal mark. Global search on right reads "Search or run a command" with "⌘K".
Sidebar exact labels: "Overview", selected "Workloads", "MicroVMs", "Images", selected-adjacent "Cache", "Storage", "Build", bottom "Settings". Lower sidebar runtime health shows green dot + "Runtime ready", smaller "Apple · Local".
Main area: title "Workloads", secondary "5 running · 6 total". Top calm resource strip has "CPU" / "0.42 cores" with blue sparkline, "Memory" / "1.30 GiB" with muted teal sparkline, "Cache" / "24 contexts" smaller "7 active mounts". One primary blue "Run" button.
Segmented filter "All", "Running", "Stopped"; subtle search "Filter workloads". Table columns "Name", "Type", "State", "CPU", "Memory", "Port". Group heading "web-dev". Rows exact:
"api-dev" / "Container" / "Running" / "0.18" / "384 MiB" / "8080"; selected in restrained blue tint.
"postgres" / "Container" / "Running" / "0.04" / "256 MiB" / "5432".
"redis" / "Container" / "Running" / "0.01" / "48 MiB" / "6379".
"worker" / "Container" / "Running" / "0.07" / "128 MiB" / "—".
Group heading "Standalone".
"ubuntu-ci" / "MicroVM" / "Running" / "0.12" / "512 MiB" / "—".
"docs-preview" / "Container" / "Stopped" / "—" / "—" / "—".
Use small consistent 1.75pt outline icons, a green status dot with "Running" text, hollow gray dot for "Stopped". Table CPU units caption "CPU measured in cores".
Right inspector: title "api-dev", green dot "Running", small metadata "node:22-alpine · Apple". Small stop square and restart controls. Tabs "Overview", selected "Logs", "Metrics", "Terminal". Logs toolbar search + green dot "Live" + pause icon. Readable monospace short log lines: "10:42:18 INFO Listening on :8080", "10:42:19 INFO Cache mount ready", "10:42:23 WARN Pool nearing limit", "10:42:24 INFO GET /health 200". Wrap lines cleanly. A compact lower info section "Local cache" and "npm packages · In use" with a subtle shield/lock glyph. Bottom shows "Open :8080" as a quiet link.
Bottom activity strip: "Image pulled · node:22-alpine", right "Updated 2s ago · Illustrative data".
Constraints: sharp readable exact labels; realistic native proportions; high usability and keyboard discoverability; no marketing headline outside app, no watermarks, no decorative 3D boxes, no neon glow, no giant empty hero, no gradients in charts, no spurious extra nav groups. This is a visual concept with illustrative metrics, not claimed measured performance.

assets.name: Menu bar
assets.originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity native macOS menu bar popover for Micropod.
Primary request: Design the companion menu bar app to a fast container and microVM manager. A crisp compact native popover, exceptionally readable and practical, showing runtime health, workload resources, local cache and direct actions.
Scene/backdrop: a close crop of a macOS desktop with a thin menu bar across the top. Micropod's tiny white horizontal pod/terminal mark in the menu bar has an anchored popover directly below it. Only one popover, no device, no desk, no marketing copy. Very subdued neutral graphite desktop.
Style/medium: realistic native dark macOS UI. SF Pro typography; graphite translucent rounded popover; restrained #0A84FF blue accent; hairline dividers; quiet white and gray typography. Every row comfortably readable. No huge cards, no neon.
Composition: portrait-ish or square canvas; center the 360pt wide popover, rendered large at 2x. Popover visually dominates canvas. Keep thin top menu bar visible. Precisely spaced sections and generous horizontal padding, 14pt corner radius.
Exact text: header "Micropod" with small refined pod mark, green status dot "Runtime ready", small settings outline icon.
First section: "5 running" in prominent text, smaller "Containers & microVMs". Resource row has "CPU" / "0.42 cores" with tiny blue sparkline and "Memory" / "1.30 GiB" with muted teal sparkline.
Next section title "WORKLOADS", quiet "View all" on right. Three rows:
green dot "api-dev", small "Container · :8080", right "384 MiB", small quick open/logs icon.
green dot "postgres", small "Container · :5432", right "256 MiB".
green dot "ubuntu-ci", small "MicroVM", right "512 MiB".
Use small 1.75pt outline icons; rows can be clicked.
Next section title "LOCAL CACHE". Two low-profile meter rows: "Build contexts" / "1.8 / 5 GiB" and "Package chunks" / "3.2 / 10 GiB"; modest blue filled bars with gray remainder. Footer of section "7 active mounts", right subtle "Manage".
One recent activity row "node:22-alpine pulled" / "2m ago".
Bottom primary row: blue button "Run…" with play icon and neutral button "Open Micropod" with external arrow; small keyboard shortcut "⌘O". Footer faint "Updated 2s ago · Illustrative data".
Constraints: native macOS popover anchored to menu bar; data consistent with main app; clean type hierarchy; full popover visible, no clipped content; no illustrated or 3D container mascots, no watermarks, no excessive ornament. This is a proposed UI using sample data.

assets.name: Cache workspace
assets.originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity native macOS cache management screen for Micropod.
Primary request: Design a local cache workspace that makes intelligent caching transparent, useful and safe. Visually match a crisp graphite macOS developer utility with blue pod/terminal identity.
Scene/backdrop: straight-on large macOS application window, landscape 16:10, almost fills canvas on neutral background, native traffic lights and unified toolbar. No device frame.
Style/medium: high fidelity SwiftUI screenshot, SF Pro UI typography, SF Mono identifiers. Calm graphite dark surfaces, quiet thin borders, restrained #0A84FF accent, muted teal active state. Clean useful rows rather than oversized cards.
Composition: 190pt sidebar, main content fills remaining space. Sidebar exact labels: "Overview", "Workloads", "MicroVMs", "Images", selected "Cache", "Storage", "Build", bottom "Settings"; runtime footer "Runtime ready" with green dot. App toolbar "Micropod" and search "Search or run a command" / "⌘K".
Main title "Cache", subtitle "Reuse local work. Keep storage predictable." Top-right secondary "Cache settings", blue button "Review cleanup".
Top three balanced compact panels:
"Build contexts" / "1.8 / 5 GiB" / "24 retained" with slim budget meter.
"Package chunks" / "3.2 / 10 GiB" / "7 active mounts" with slim budget meter.
"Reused content" / "640 MiB" / "Across build contexts" with outline overlapping-files glyph, no savings claim.
Below exact short explanation: "Active caches stay protected. Older unused entries leave first." Small explanatory info icon.
Tabs "Build contexts", selected "Package cache", "Cache volumes". Filter field "Find a cache", dropdown "All projects".
Table headers "Cache", "Project", "Last used", "Content", "State".
Rows:
"npm packages" subline "/root/.npm"; "web-dev"; "Just now"; "840 MiB"; blue/green pill "In use".
"Go modules" subline "/go/pkg/mod"; "ubuntu-ci"; "2m ago"; "1.1 GiB"; "In use".
"pip downloads" subline "/root/.cache/pip"; "ml-tools"; "1h ago"; "620 MiB"; neutral pill "Kept" and small pin icon.
"npm packages" subline "/root/.npm"; "docs-preview"; "Yesterday"; "180 MiB"; "Unused".
Each row uses relevant understated cache symbol and an overflow control. Include small footnote "Content size can share chunks; rows do not add up to stored bytes."
Below table a quiet cleanup preview area on right side occupying bottom third at most: heading "Cleanup preview", small exact copy "Unused entries only"; three clear checkmarked protections "Active mounts protected", "Kept entries protected", "Base volumes protected". Bottom "Review 3 entries" with neutral button. Show no automatic destructive action, no invented physical reclaim number.
Bottom activity strip "Cache ready · Local only", right "Illustrative data".
Constraints: clear type hierarchy and honest units; do not display hit percentage, speedups, time saved, cloud cache, or a combined disk-savings number. Retained contexts and local chunk budgets are separate. Pinning and cleanup are proposed product controls. No marketing layout, neon, decorative cubes, watermark.

assets.name: App icon
assets.originalPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a single high resolution macOS app icon concept for Micropod, a native container and microVM manager.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference for Micropod's existing identity: blue horizontal pod outline with terminal bars and a forward chevron.
Primary request: Refine that existing pod-and-terminal silhouette into a beautifully balanced macOS app icon. Keep the recognizable horizontal pod outline, internal vertical terminal bars and forward arrow cue, simplify tiny details to remain legible at 16px. Render as a clean bold white glyph centered on a rich Micropod blue squircle.
Style/medium: polished native app icon, restrained satin blue tile with very subtle depth on its outer rounded edge; the white glyph itself is flat and perfectly sharp. Blue uses the established #0A84FF family.
Composition: square canvas, single icon occupying 85% of canvas, centered, generous optical breathing room around glyph. A softly rounded square with no perspective. Thin quiet edge highlight. Neutral very pale gray backdrop.
Constraints: only one icon; retain existing brand geometry; no text, no wordmark, no letters, no watermark, no floating 3D cube, no chrome, no neon, no extra badges. Clear original pod silhouette.

assets.name: Design-system board
assets.originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: a concise visual design-system board for the Micropod native macOS app.
Input images: Image 1 is the brand reference: the blue app tile with a white horizontal pod outline, three terminal bars and a forward chevron. Preserve that recognizable logo geometry.
Primary request: Produce a beautifully composed, practical design-system sheet connecting logo, native typography, colors, statuses, components and outline iconography for the same container and microVM manager.
Style/medium: sharp editorial UI specimen board on warm off-white, a controlled dark graphite specimen region, SF Pro/system typography, small code text in SF Mono. Use existing Micropod #0A84FF identity, charcoal, neutral gray and muted teal. Restrained, native and precise.
Composition: landscape 3:2 board, aligned grid, generous whitespace, no photographic scene or device. Upper left lowercase wordmark "micropod" next to the refined blue pod/terminal mark; subtitle "macOS design system". Upper right a modest blue app-icon tile matching Image 1.
Grid sections:
"01 / Identity" with blue mark on white, white mark on graphite, and a tiny 16px menu-bar template sample.
"02 / Color" with six clear swatches labeled "Brand #0A84FF", "Canvas #151719", "Surface #1F2328", "Text #F3F5F7", "Success #68D6A0", "Warning #E6B65D".
"03 / Type" with "SF Pro" large, sample "Workloads" in semibold, "5 running · 6 total" regular, "SF Mono" and "10:42:24 INFO GET /health 200" in mono.
"04 / Components" on a dark graphite region: blue primary button "Run", secondary button "Review cleanup", green-dot pill "Running", hollow-dot pill "Stopped", pin-pill "Kept"; compact selected row "api-dev" / "Container" / "0.18 cores" / "384 MiB"; budget meter "Package chunks" / "3.2 / 10 GiB".
"05 / Iconography" with a single coherent 1.75pt outline icon family, 12 clearly labeled glyphs: "Workloads", "Container", "MicroVM", "Cache", "CPU", "Memory", "Logs", "Terminal", "Run", "Stop", "Restart", "Settings". Match rounded caps and joins and 24px grid with 2px safe margins. These are visual specimens, do not dominate the sheet.
Small bottom line "Native macOS · 4pt spacing · 24px icon grid · Concept".
Constraints: do not add slogans, cloud features, extra palette, illustrations, 3D cubes, neon, watermark, huge typography or poster-like marketing. Legible exact words; practical component hierarchy. Components are proposed and numeric data is illustrative.
